newsitem.title: UK: ROYAL BANK SCOTLAND FALLS ON PLACING NEWS.
newsitem.headline: ROYAL BANK SCOTLAND FALLS ON PLACING NEWS.

text.p: Shares in the Royal Bank of Scotland Group Plc of Scotland Plc reversed earlier gains on Wednesday after the company announced a 33 million share placing, dealers said.
The stock fell 16-1/2p to 609p by 1510 GMT, after reaching a high of 633p earlier in the day.
"We've seen sellers on the back of the placing they are doing at 601p," said one trader.

Royal Bank announced earlier that it had agreed to place the new shares with Scottish Widows Fund and Life Assurances Society at 601.1725p per share, which depressed the current market price, dealers said.

"They sold all these shares to Scottish Widows to fund a deal and left everybody else in the market out, so no-one had a chance to participate and sentiment has turned on that," said the head of market-making at a leading brokerage.
The market had initially welcomed the terms of Royal Bank's acquisition of the Birmingham Midshires building society announced on Wednesday.

The bank said it had agreed to pay between 605-630 million stg for Midshires and said the purchase would be done without recourse to an equity issue. Royal Bank added that it was still interested in striking a larger deal in its ambition to grow.
